title: fix(metadata-protocol): the 409 that makes a controlled_by_parent master required counts the rows with no master
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQKN4hcnpATFdcNUrQvaJk3)_

Fixes #28665

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把一个从表里查出来的数字写进已有的 409 提示文案。把子对象设为「受父对象控制」、同时把主从关系设为必填时，服务端会数出有多少行还没有父记录，告诉作者这些行会被所有人（包括管理员）看不到，并提示先补上父记录。
- **为什么改**：以前只说「空值行可能校验失败」，严重低估了后果：强制保存并发布后，这些行仍在库里，但任何入口都读不到也改不了（ADR-0055 的 fail-closed 规则）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。409 照常出现，`?force=true` 照常放行，错误码和结构都不变；只有匹配那一种情形时多一次 count 查询，查询失败就退回原来的文案。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-destructive-null-master.ts`（判定条件与新文案）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 里 Phase 3a-destructive 门的那一处调用（count 查询的写法）；`packages/objectql/src/protocol-destructive-null-master.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-destructive-null-master.test.ts`（需先 build `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`），预期 8/8 通过；main 上是 3 失败。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-destructive-null-master.ts` (new): `withNullMasterRowCounts(findings, next, objectName, count)`. It picks the `field_required_no_default` findings whose field is a `master_detail` of a body whose `sharingModel` is `controlled_by_parent`. That covers both a detail switched to `controlled_by_parent` in this save and one that already was. For each one it asks `count`, and when the answer is positive it rewrites that finding's `message`. Nothing else changes: findings that do not match, a zero count and a count that throws all come back as they were, in the same order.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: one call site in `saveMetaItem`'s Phase 3a-destructive gate, wrapping `detectDestructiveObjectChanges(prev, request.item)`. The counter is `this.engine.count(request.name, { where: { [field]: { $null: true } }, context: { isSystem: true } })`. That is system authority, because the question is what the table holds, not what the caller can read. The detector itself is untouched. It stays sync and reads only the two definitions. The gate already runs only when `!request.force`, so a forced save issues no count.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-destructive-null-master.test.ts` (new): pins through the real `saveMetaItem` gate, using the `protocol-destructive.test.ts` harness (tenant-authored objects in a `SchemaRegistry` and a mock engine whose `count` answers from a row list by the `$null` predicate it is handed).
- `.changeset/28665-cbp-null-master-count.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch. `files[]` ships `dist`, and the new text is in `dist/index.js` after a build.

The new message, with N = 2 (with N = 1 it says "1 existing row has no 'project' … it becomes … Set 'project' on that row first."):

> Field 'project' is now required but has no default value, and 'qow_task' is controlled by its parent: 2 existing rows have no 'project', and once the object is controlled by its parent they become unreadable through every door, the admin's included (a detail with no master has no reader, ADR-0055). Set 'project' on each of them first.

Untouched, as ruled: ADR-0055 access derivation, plugin-security, any repair door, `ui/**`. No issue code, structured member or spec key is added, so `Clause-②: no` holds. No line of #28564's doors or #25467's `parseCommitItems` is touched. The one `saveMetaItem` line is the gate's own call to the detector.

## Why

Since #27458, Studio's "Make required and save" re-sends the draft with `?force=true` after a 409 whose finding said only "existing rows with null values may fail validation". Under `controlled_by_parent` a detail derives every reader from its master, and plugin-security fails closed on a row with none. So after publish those rows answer `total: 0` on the list and 404 on the by-id read and write, the admin included, while they stay stored. The card's live reproduction is below, base vs head.

## The Studio confirm: the `domain:ui` follow-up

`PackageOwdOverviewPanel` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx`, about L424–L431 and L498–L503) already lists every `issues[].message` from the 409 in its confirm. So the count reaches the author with **no console change**, and the field to relay is `issues[].message` of the `field_required_no_default` entry. The follow-up the seat files is only owed if the console wants more than that, for example a localized sentence, or a "stop" path that sends the author to fix the rows first. That needs a structured count, which would be a new published member (`Clause-②: yes`) and is not added here.

## Tests

<details><summary>Red on base (dist built from 2678600d), green at head</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-destructive-null-master.test.ts` after building the `@objectstack/objectql^...` closure. The subject is imported as `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, which resolves to `dist/`, so every leg rebuilt that package first.

Base (`protocol.ts` at `2678600d`, helper absent):

```
× names how many stored rows have no master and that they become unreadable through every door
× counts too when the detail already was controlled_by_parent and its master becomes required now
× with no masterless row the finding is today's, unchanged
AssertionError: expected 'Field \'project\' is now required but…' to contain '2 existing rows have no \'project\''
AssertionError: expected 'Field \'project\' is now required but…' to contain '1 existing row has no \'project\''
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times
Tests  3 failed | 5 passed (8)
```

Head (with `protocol-destructive.test.ts` beside it): `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 15 passed (15) · VERDICT command-exit 0`. Same again after merging `origin/main` `a06feb76` and rebuilding.

The eight cases:
- 2 masterless rows: 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`. The finding and `err.message` name "2 existing rows have no 'project'" and "unreadable through every door". There is exactly one `count('qow_task', { where: { project: { $null: true } }, context: { isSystem: true } })`. Run on the direct save and on `mode: 'draft'`.
- A detail already `controlled_by_parent` whose master becomes required now: counted ("1 existing row").
- Zero masterless rows: the finding is today's text, byte for byte. One count.
- A count that throws: today's text, and the 409 stands.
- `force: true`: `success: true`, no count.
- No count: a master made required on a `private` detail (today's text); another field made required on a `controlled_by_parent` detail; an ordinary save with no destructive change (`success: true`).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the count removed, three pins red; restored, green</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-destructive-null-master.ts --anchor 'if (masters.length === 0) return findings;' --replacement 'if (masters.length >= 0) return findings;' -- bash ablate-leg.sh`. The leg rebuilds `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, runs `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` for the marker, then runs the suite.

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob b97adc28f536 -> 2a91551eaa9a
✓ dist/: marker present in 2 built files -- the ablation is live in the artifact the suite consumes.
× names how many stored rows have no master and that they become unreadable through every door
× counts too when the detail already was controlled_by_parent and its master becomes required now
× with no masterless row the finding is today's, unchanged
Tests  3 failed | 5 passed (8)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (b97adc28f536) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Restore leg: rebuild, then `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs … --absent` gives "✓ dist/: marker absent from all 24 built files", and the suite gives `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
</details>

<details><summary>Live probe: the card's steps 1–3 on a stock showcase boot, base vs head</summary>

`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT`, then `probe.sh PORT app.qow`: sign in as `admin@objectos.ai`, `POST /api/v1/packages` (`app.qow`), draft and publish `qow_project` and `qow_task` (`project` a `master_detail`, not required), `POST /api/v1/data/qow_task` twice with no project and once with one, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qow_task?mode=draft&package=app.qow` with `sharingModel: "controlled_by_parent"` and `fields.project.required: true`.

Base (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt from `2678600d`'s `protocol.ts`):

```
{"error":"object/qow_task would drop or transform existing data: Field 'project' is now required but has no default value — existing rows with null values may fail validation. — re-submit with ?force=true to proceed.","code":"DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE","issues":[{"code":"field_required_no_default","field":"project","message":"Field 'project' is now required but has no default value — existing rows with null values may fail validation."}]}
HTTP 409
```

Head:

```
{"error":"object/qow_task would drop or transform existing data: Field 'project' is now required but has no default value, and 'qow_task' is controlled by its parent: 2 existing rows have no 'project', and once the object is controlled by its parent they become unreadable through every door, the admin's included (a detail with no master has no reader, ADR-0055). Set 'project' on each of them first. — re-submit with ?force=true to proceed.","code":"DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE","issues":[{"code":"field_required_no_default","field":"project","message":"Field 'project' is now required but has no default value, and 'qow_task' is controlled by its parent: 2 existing rows have no 'project', …"}]}
HTTP 409
```

On both: `?force=true` gives 200, `publish-drafts` gives `{"outcome":"published","published":1}`, and the admin's `GET /api/v1/data/qow_task` gives `{"total":1}` of the 3 stored rows. That is the consequence the head text now names, and it is unchanged, as ruled.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Not covered: a detail switched to `controlled_by_parent` whose master was already required.** Such a save raises no finding today, so no 409 carries a count. Masterless rows can still exist there, for example rows stored before an earlier forced required toggle. Raising a new 409 for that case would be a new block, which ruling 2 excludes, so it is reported to the seat as an open question rather than built. The Studio panel never reaches this case with a 409: it sends the master required in the same save.
- When a save has more than three findings, the 409's top-level text quotes the first three. `issues[]` always carries the counted finding.

## Verification

Gates and package suites at final head `01fa82d0` (merge of `origin/main` `a06feb76`): see the os-dev-report on #28665 for each command and exit code. In short: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` 0, its suite 291 files / 21950 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` 0, its `local` suite 513 files / 9906 tests passed; `eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol packages/objectql` 0; the derived gate list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 62 families), each exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
